subject: Re: Executive briefing schedule & sponsor playbook — Pinnacle Health close
body:
From: Elena Cortez <ecortez@pinnaclehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@pinnaclehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Executive briefings and vendor MAPs

Hi Karthik,

Wanted to follow up after the demo — leadership is receptive but wants a clear map (timeline + exec brief cadence) before we move to procurement. Can you share an executive-sponsor plan and a proposed EB cadence? Amit and I need something to present in our steering committee next Tuesday.

High level ask:
- Which Pinnacle execs should we involve (we expect CFO + CIO + Head of Data)
- Proposed EB agenda (30-45 min) and pre-read
- Target close timeline (legal/procurement milestones) and any gating items from Redwood

Thanks — we hope to keep this to a 3–6 week close window if possible.

— Elena
Director, Digital Transformation
Pinnacle Health

----------------------------

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Cortez <ecortez@pinnaclehealth.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@pinnaclehealth.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive briefings and vendor MAPs

Hi Elena — great to hear leadership is aligned.

I put together an initial sponsor playbook and EB cadence below; attaching a working MAP and agenda. Happy to adjust based on your steering committee input.

Quick proposal (high level):
- Exec Sponsor Mapping:
  - CIO (primary exec sponsor) — 1:1 intro + invite to EB (30 min)
  - CFO (economics owner) — join EB for topline TCO and pilot economics (20 min)
  - Head of Data (technical sponsor) — technical deep-dive follow-up (30 min)
- EB cadence (single session to accelerate close):
  - 35–45 minute executive briefing (intro, top customer outcomes, risks & mitigations, commercial ask)
  - Pre-read: 1-page MAP summary + short TCO appendix (sent 48 hours prior)
  - Follow-ups: tech deep-dive with Head of Data + sandbox access within 5 business days
- Target close timeline (recommended):
  - Week 0: EB + obtain commercial alignment
  - Week 1–2: Procurement / Security questionnaire turnaround (we will assist with SOC2 evidence)
  - Week 3: Final legal redlines and signature (DocuSign)

Attached: Pinnacle_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), Exec_Brief_Agenda_v2.pdf

Next steps I suggest:
1) Can you confirm the preferred EB date/time window (we can offer two 30–45m slots next Tue/Wed)
2) I'll loop in Marissa (CS) to coordinate logistics and the pre-read
3) Prio: share any procurement/agreement constraints you have so we flag them early

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

----------------------------

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Cortez <ecortez@pinnaclehealth.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Executive briefings and vendor MAPs

Hi Elena — looping in Laura from CS to prep the EB logistics and pre-read.

Suggested EB slots (PST):
- Tue, Nov 24 — 09:00–09:45 or 13:00–13:45
- Wed, Nov 25 — 10:00–10:45

Pre-read packet we will provide: 1) MAP one-pager, 2) Exec agenda, 3) Example SLAs + pilot checklist.

Attachment: Exec_Brief_Agenda_v2.pdf (agenda draft)

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Director
Redwood Inference

----------------------------

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Cortez <ecortez@pinnaclehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:07:00 -0800
Subject: Updated MAP + gating checklist for Pinnacle (v2)

Team — attached an updated MAP (Pinnacle_MAP_v1.xlsx -> Pinnacle_MAP_v2.xlsx) with clearer owner assignments and procurement gating items. Key additions:
- Security evidence owner: Redwood Security (SOC2 + encryption KMS notes)
- Pilot environment timeline: sandbox within 5 business days after EB
- Legal standard exceptions: data residency & indemnity callouts (flagged for legal)

I also added a short gating checklist for procurement: vendor risk assessment, data processing addendum, pilot acceptance criteria. Laura/Marissa — please use this when you prep the pre-read.

Attachment: Pinnacle_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP draft, tracks owners)

— Priyom
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

----------------------------

From: Elena Cortez <ecortez@pinnaclehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@pinnaclehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Executive briefings and vendor MAPs

Thanks everyone — steering committee confirmed Wed Nov 25 10:00–10:45 PST. We'll take the 35-minute slot.

Action items from our side:
- I'll share a one-pager with the CIO & CFO by EOD Tue (Nov 24)
- Procurement will send any special commercial constraints by Fri Nov 27

From Redwood: please send final EB pre-read and MAP v2 by EOD Tue so we can include it in the pack. Also confirm who from Redwood will present the short economics section for the CFO.

Elena
